entities.name: Urhaalan Valley
entities.description: An area in northwestern Terisiare populated by goblins and Urhaalan minotaurs, later destroyed by the Great Glacier.

entities.name: Urhaalan minotaurs
entities.description: A minotaur tribe divided into clans, decimated in a war with the elves of Eln Forest.

entities.name: Eln Forest
entities.description: Forest of the elves who fought the Urhaalan minotaurs.

entities.name: Sacumon
entities.description: A sorceress whose schemes brought the minotaurs and elves into conflict.

entities.name: Tiyint
entities.description: Legendary hero whose essence was awakened into a stone colossus.

entities.name: Great Glacier
entities.description: The widening glacier that covered and destroyed the valley at the onset of the Ice Age.

events.summary: Through Sacumon's schemes the Urhaalan minotaurs come into conflict with the elves of Eln Forest, escalating into war that decimates the minotaurs.
events.quote: This escalated into an all-out war, which decimated the population of the Urhaalan minotaurs

events.summary: The stone colossus of Tiyint is awakened for the Urhaalan but turns on them until deactivated.
events.quote: eventually turned on them until its deactivation

events.summary: The Great Glacier slowly covers and destroys the valley.
events.quote: Urhaalan Valley was slowly covered and destroyed by the widening Great Glacier .

relations.note: Her schemes provoked their war with the elves.
relations.quote: through the schemes of the sorceress Sacumon
